scope: identity-safe dense Prithvi token fusion on development fold 2

architecture.foundation: frozen Prithvi-EO-2.0 tiny temporal target-minus-reference maps from encoder blocks 3, 6, 9, and 12
architecture.fusion: per-depth token normalization/projection plus explicit spectral-physics features injected through zero-initialized gates at U-Net levels 3, 4, and 5
architecture.segmentation_identity: zero deep gates reproduce released logits exactly
architecture.scene_identity: zero final residual reproduces the current cross-fitted spatial/Prithvi ensemble score exactly
architecture.auxiliary_supervision: 8x8 plume-occupancy head plus pixel focal/Dice, scene BCE, and pair ranking
architecture.inference_contract: released U-Net plus Prithvi token extractor plus current cross-fitted ranker

training.endpoint_rule: fixed epoch 3; no held-fold epoch selection
training.sampling: equal request mass for each label x sensor stratum, then equal physical-site mass within stratum
training.augmentation: joint quarter-turn and reflection transforms applied identically to 200x200 MARS inputs and 8x8 token maps
training.simulation: none; cached foundation features bind each real temporal pair and cannot represent an on-the-fly synthetic injection

search.rule: apply the same residual strength to dense logits and the cross-fitted scene logit
search.mask_rule: sensor thresholds Sentinel-2 0.80 and Landsat 0.70, minimum 100 connected pixels, empty below scene score 0.75

gates.paired_site_pixel_iou_interval: reported now; must be strictly positive in the later full-development cross-fit
gates.pass_action: freeze a separate multi-seed full-development cross-fit; no external scoring

invariants: The GPU smoke must validate exact released-logit and current-scene-score identity plus finite optimization.
All 44,363 token rows must align to the frozen manifest, folds, labels, sensors, and physical sites.
No fresh external or exact-paper input is loaded.
Fold 2 is reused selection evidence and cannot serve as independent confirmation.
Only fixed epoch 3 and three predeclared residual strengths are scored.
Failure writes no artifact and cannot authorize external scoring.
The 4.36 GB feature cache and any checkpoint remain Git-ignored.
